who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor T2 of 7b-launched, int-1112
what: The launch host took only a whole build (`Program::built` of a `Built` with every function and static of the reached closure), so a launched run could not start before the daemon had compiled, recorded and held everything it could reach: a cold hello-world took 9,727 ms against Relax's 220 ms and the daemon held 351 MB of codegen and link memory. A record also named the program's own symbols as Extern places, which the launcher fills by dlsym and the wire cannot number.
cost: every launched cold start paid the whole closure; the 73 ms target was out of reach by design
cause: the program's interface was a whole-build value, so the unit of what the host takes was the build, not the function
class: an interface whose unit is a container (the build) where the consumer needs the item (one function at its first call)
prevention: the host takes pieces (`Piece`, `Bound`) by slot identity; a bind record carries one function's record with its names and is read with no database; a lazy program is held to the whole build's binds by a refinement test
fix: Program::started takes the start, Program::said gives Said::Want for a slot it does not hold, Program::took binds the piece the driver answers with; bind.rs encodes a Bound under bind_key(ask, naming, policy, symbols, maker). Controls: Plant::StaleSlot, Plant::DropsStaticNames, Plant::WantTwice. Not yet compiled: the main agent builds it, T3 rewrites the driver.
